controls.pixelPickingDescription: A few native pixels, plus unquantified cartographic generalization. This is not an absolute uncertainty bound.
controls.correspondenceEvidence: Henits numbered contour-junction geometry, cross-checked against the matching gray road network in KSH2014 figure1 derived from the same KSH2003 scheme. Actual original OSM road nodes provide geographic positions.

sourcePrintedScaleDiagnostic.meaning: Printed scale consistency check only; manual bar endpoints and unknown map generalization do not establish absolute accuracy.

affineSixControl.meaning: Six-parameter model allows shear/anisotropic scale; retained only as a placement hypothesis.

threeJunctionSimilarity.meaning: Alternate sparse-junction placement hypothesis, not an additional quarter or confidence envelope.

limitations: Source is a generalized2003-era quarter map reproduced in a2013 dissertation; it is not a surveyed current neighborhood boundary.
Road-junction identification is manual and uses a KSH2014 companion map to identify physical source features; body-source number-key differences remain isolated.
Six controls cover central/northern Szeged. The southwest/east cohort extends beyond their convex hull, so placement is extrapolated using the map similarity assumption.
Control residuals, map scale and differences between retained models are diagnostic only; absolute positional accuracy remains unknown.
Source50/60/70 threshold variants describe inside-edge source-raster interpretation, not geographical accuracy.
